headlines.detail: On track after lap 1 · most: BOR (7)

summary: Kimi Antonelli won the United States Grand Prix from pole position, 13.1s ahead of Charles Leclerc, with Max Verstappen completing the podium.
Gabriel Bortoleto made the biggest climb, from P21 to P13.
Fernando Alonso had a day to forget, dropping from P12 to P16.
The race was neutralised by 2 virtual safety cars.
The stewards penalised RUS (5 second time penalty) and BEA (10 second time penalty).
There were 32 pit stops in total; the winner stopped once.
Kimi Antonelli leads the championship by 123 points over George Russell.
